name: Deduction Auto-Validation
summary: Auto-validation is already past the 40% target. It is highest on contract deductions with a clean programme match, and lowest on borderline operational claims that still need analyst review.

drivers.name: Validity confidence mix
drivers.narrative: High-confidence valid/invalid auto-resolve; "review" needs a human.
drivers.rootCause: Borderline operational deductions (pricing, shortage) carry lower model confidence and route to analysts; more resolution history raises confidence over time.

drivers.name: Contract vs operational
drivers.narrative: Contract (GPO/rebate) deductions auto-validate far better than operational ones.
drivers.rootCause: Contract deductions match deterministically against TPM programmes; operational claims depend on freight/quality evidence that is harder to auto-verify.

drivers.name: Programme match rate
drivers.narrative: Trade deduction match outcomes against GPO/rebate programmes.
drivers.rootCause: Mismatches and "no programme" cases arise from SKU/model or date gaps in the TPM feed; tightening the Vistex sync lifts the auto rate.
